corrections: Same community revision as the prior pass. No contradiction of the Hall-preserves-characters finding was found. Extend prior save/offline omissions: indexedDB character/Hall stores have a localStorage fallback; offline overflow is banked and later consumed through turbo updates. GEvent.rand has an empty branch in the inspected unlock method, so declared random event data is not proof of a working randomized scheduler.

A01.summary: Shown: event/quest descriptions and encounter narration emit log messages; GEvent unlock can change state/loot through the item mechanism. No speaker/portrait/reply-tree schema established in inspected families. All quest and encounter records remain unread.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Use a narrated work consequence with a real state receipt rather than assuming every event is a conversation. Owner: docs/worlds/PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md; src/data/dialogues.js; src/life_record.js.

A02.summary: Shown: typed log categories record unlocks, loot, titles, combat, retreat and events. Unlock buffering can bundle multiple items into one summary with details. This supports progression narrative, not a full branching social campaign.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Bundle related unlock notices while keeping individual known facts inspectable. Owner: docs/worlds/PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md; src/data/dialogues.js; src/life_record.js.

A03.summary: Shown: Vue reactive state, JSON data loader, typed item classes, inventories/composites/modules, and game/system event buses. Main update evaluates tech tree then timed state updates. Content merges into instantiated objects rather than being only hard-coded UI.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Extend existing registries and one simulation clock; avoid a parallel wizard engine. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.

A04.summary: Shown: JSON state stores version, persistent character ID, lastUpdate, item state, slot IDs, gear, combat and exploration. Profile saves active characters separately from Hall. IndexedDB stores chars/Hall; localStorage is marked fallback. Index exports character or full Hall and routes imported shape accordingly. Legacy resave exists; no all-version semantic migration, quota safety or atomic multi-character import proved.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Keep character identity, shared meta and authored definitions separate in persistence. Owner: src/save_files.js; src/save_compatibility.js.

A05.summary: Shown: combat uses actors, actions and target selection; minions distinguish owned inventory from active allies, keep rules and capacity. Full target policy, spells and autonomous NPC schedules unread.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Distinguish a recruited ally from one assigned to the current fight. Owner: src/npc_lives.js; world CAMPAIGN.md.

A06.summary: Shown: separate resource/running panes, filters, skill progress and Hall switching. Reactive item state powers progress/capacity views. Desktop layout/keyboard use not exercised.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: At 1440x900, keep work, resource capacity and known study options independently visible. Owner: docs/THEMATIC_UI_AND_INFORMATION_DESIGN_2026-10-12.md.

A07.summary: Shown: JSON catalogues, module selection and parser/tech-tree instantiate requirements and values; runtime classes supply behavior. Full extension ordering and validation rules remain partial. No arbitrary public mod-loader contract established.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Author techniques with IDs, explicit prerequisites and named effect consumers. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.

A08.summary: Shown: value/property/stat classes and authored resource caps/skill/furniture modifiers. Furniture changes useful tasks/capacity, not only flavor. Every growth curve, combat modifier and RNG policy remains unread.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Make a bench change one actual task or capacity with a named source. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.

A09.summary: Shown: oversized wall-clock delta banks overflow in offlinetime; turbo consumes that store with coarse ticks and a fractional remainder. Tech-tree reevaluation occurs between coarse updates. This is not a proven exact fine-tick replay or unlimited offline production.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Document coarse versus fine time semantics before choosing an absence policy. Owner: src/feature_expansion_work_plan.js; src/simulation.js.

A10.summary: Shown: prerequisites progressively unlock tasks/classes/furnishings; combat tutorial is a named module. Complete early-to-late class closure unread.

A11.summary: Shown: grouped unlock logs, filter/hide controls, progress and stop/rest/resume feedback. No measured accessibility or animation claim.
